title: Complexity Citation Tuple
description: Canonical citation form by which downstream foundation ADRs (0.0.28 / 0.0.29 / 0.0.30) reference distilled-characteristics documents (ADR-0.0.27, OBPI-0.0.27-05). Mirrors the Pydantic model at src/gzkit/complexity/citation.py with extra='forbid'; consumed by the link-integrity validator (OBPI-0.0.27-07).

distilled_characteristics_path.description: Relative path to the cited distilled-characteristics document; must live under docs/governance/complexity/.

section_anchor.description: Slugified anchor identifying the metric section within the document.

corpus_revision.description: Corpus revision the citation was authored against (positive integer).
